_: Kling O3. Same tiers as V3 plus reference-to-video and two video-to-video routes. Prices are fal's own; genmedia reports a flat $0.14 for every one of them.

fal-ai/kling-video/o3/standard/text-to-v.displayName: Kling O3 Standard Text to Video
fal-ai/kling-video/o3/standard/text-to-v.description: Kling O3 at the standard tier, writing a clip from a sentence. Audio is generated unless you turn it off, and costs more when it is.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.084 per second of output with audio off and $0.112 with it on. Priced from the audio-on default and scaled down when it is off. genmedia reports a flat $0.14 for every Kling O3 route.

fal-ai/kling-video/o3/standard/video-to-.description: Rewrites a clip you already have, following the prompt, at the standard tier.

pricing.note: fal publishes a flat $0.126 per second of output. genmedia reports $0.14. It has no length control: the output is as long as the clip it is given, which fal limits to fifteen seconds, so the hold assumes that ceiling and settle returns the rest.
